label: Formal fact: 'whatever is moved has a mover' together with 'every mover is in act in the respect'…
paraphrase: Formal fact: 'whatever is moved has a mover' together with 'every mover is in act in the respect' entails 'whatever is moved has a mover in act in the respect', which entails 'whatever is moved has a mover' but not 'every mover is in act'; and even with every prima via premise it does not entail that act is simply prior to potency.
